verdict.rationale: Adyen documents public server-side APIs: the Checkout API endpoints (/sessions, /paymentMethods, /payments, /payments/details), the Management API, idempotency keys, and scoped API credentials. Its OpenAPI repository is described as covering every public API and as the single source of truth, and a community member reports implementing the integration hands-on. Missing for 10: no hands-on probe exercising the API endpoints themselves, and no OpenAPI spec served from the docs domain (all probed paths returned 404; the specs live on GitHub).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Your server makes three Checkout API requests: /paymentMethods, /payments, and /payments/details.
contains OpenAPI specifications for every public API Adyen offers. These specifications are the single source of truth for our APIs
The Adyen API supports idempotency, allowing you to retry a request multiple times while only performing the action once.
I implemented Adyen for a company I was consulting for. I liked it.
